newsitem.title: USA: Vallen unit makes 50-pct stake purchase.
newsitem.headline: Vallen unit makes 50-pct stake purchase.

text.p: Vallen Corp said Monday its Vallen Safety Supply Co Ltd unit agreed to buy a 50-percent equity stake in Superior Safety, effective September 1.
Under the agreement in principle, Vallen will have the option at a later date to purchase the remaining voting stock of Superior. Terms were not disclosed.
Superior Safety, based in Waterloo, Ontario, is a distributor of safety training products and services.
Vallen Safety is a wholesaler of safety and health protection equipment with 150 locations throughout the U.S., Canada and Mexico.
